## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what's missing or awkward today?

## Proposed change

The skill, tell, language, or improvement you have in mind. Be as concrete as you
can — an example sentence helps a lot.

## Scope fit

How does this stay generic and reusable across authors and blogs? (See the
project scope in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/vnovakovskyi/claude-writer-skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) — anything tied to one
publication or house style is out of scope.)

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.

## Additional context

Anything else — examples, links, prior art.
